facts.text: I want you to act as a travel guide for a trip.
I want the travel guide response to be brief and concise.
I want the travel guide response to provide must-visit tourist destinations and information about cities, local culture and customs, and other relevant information.
I want the travel guide response to not provide personal opinions or recommendations.
I want the travel guide response to be limited to facts and information.
I want a 7-day trip to Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China in the winter season.
I want recommended scenic spots for each day of the 7-day trip to Hangzhou in winter.
I want West Lake (Xi Hu) included as a recommended scenic spot for Day 1 of the 7-day trip.
I want Xixi National Wetland Park included as a recommended scenic spot for Day 1 of the 7-day trip.
I am traveling as a group of friends for tourism.
I want to travel for 3 days in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China in winter.
I want 1-2 scenic spots recommended for each day.
I want scenic spots suitable for winter.
I want descriptions that show features of the scenic spots in winter.
I want descriptions that attract friends to the scenic spots.
I am traveling as a family with small kids for tourism.
I want to travel for 3 days in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China in summer.
I want 1-2 scenic spots recommended for each day.
I want scenic spots suitable for winter.

events.text: Request for a 7-day trip scenic spot plan for Hangzhou in the winter season (Day 1 includes West Lake and Xixi National Wetland Park).
Request for a 3-day Hangzhou trip with 1-2 winter-suitable scenic spots per day for a group of friends.

Request for a 3-day Hangzhou trip for a family with small kids, with summer features described and winter-suitable scenic spots recommended; Lingyin Temple must be included.
